Resolves #21459

🌿 *No visitor can leave Lists & Galleries thinking a Neo list only shows rows: here one reorders by drag, one animates every sort and one buffers 5,000 records.*

Lists & Galleries gets the rest of #21367's row. A new `examples/list/reorder` puts a release checklist beside a wall of portraits, each a list on its own store, reordered by drag through `Neo.draggable.list.SortZone`; every item shows its place, which changes only once a drop has written the store. `list/animate` publishes as a card, its toolbar wrapping on a phone. `component/carousel` (portrait slides), `list/buffered` (rows read "Record 1 of 5,000") and `list/circle` publish as tiles. The group shows six cards and six tiles.

**Merge order:** #21458 (part 1) and neomjs/pages#128 (the covers) are merged, so this diff is part 2 alone. Ada's #21486 makes the catalog specs derive their counts; once it lands, this branch takes one last merge on those two specs.

Evidence: L4 (whitebox e2e in CI for AC-1; catalog and capture specs; frames at 1440 and 390) → L4 required (AC-1..AC-6). Residual: none.

In the 368 × 218 stage the circle list renders at 60 %, so its first circle (156 × 156) sits whole inside; the carousel letterboxes its portrait (`object-fit: contain`); the buffered list's description wraps to three lines. `list/animate`'s toolbar wraps from its stylesheet. Frames below. |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The buffered rows name the count** ("Record 1 of 5,000"), so the tile shows it; the stage description says what the list renders.
- **A workbench stage description wraps.** It is a label, and a label keeps one line, so the buffered list's line ran off the stage at every width. `ConfigurationViewport.css` gives `.neo-workbench-stage-desc` `white-space: normal`; the buffered list is the only example that sets one.
- **Both covers use the default theme:** the reorder page stays light under a dark color scheme, and `list/animate` configures no theme.
- **The carousel** is 320 × 400 and capped at its stage; its sheet sizes the component's inner `.neo-carousel`, which carries a 14rem height of its own. Below 600px the portrait is letterboxed instead of cropped.
- **The circle list** is 800 × 560 with 260-px circles, three a row at 1440; below 600px it renders at 60 %.

## Cold look

Two readers without this session's context graded the unlabelled pairs from 1 to 10 (how well a newcomer understands within ten seconds what the page shows and what to do), the second reader with the order swapped:

| Released → changed | Reader 1 (released shown first) | Reader 2 (changed shown first) |
|---|---|---|
| Lists & Galleries, 1440 | 7 → 8 | 6 → 8 |
| Buffered list, 390 | 4 → 7 | 5 → 7 |

Both read the changed group page as a showcase of real list demos; the released one shows only 3D images under a "lists" title. Both noted that the headline counts more live examples than the cards in view, since it counts the tiles further down. On the buffered list, both said the new line explains what the demo proves, while the step to try (scroll, change `bufferRowRange`) stays implicit.
